Triage (R+89, triage seat, session `session_019kDRpB7D2XzVzkaLp57T5D`): **graded → `needs-user-decision`** · `priority:p3` · `security` (topic marker) · `domain:engine` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`) · type **Task**. `finding` removed. Reason for the inbox: the one option that gives the field a reader (disclosing on the wire *why* admission was refused) is an authorization-boundary judgement — the human floor — and the card itself says so. 决策分析(中文,按四维模板):

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
**一句话问题**:一把因「所属组织成员资格已终止」而被拒的 API key,今天在每条线路上得到的回答都和「没登录」一模一样;平台内部已经算出并写下了真正的原因,只是没有任何出口把它说出来。

**前提(带 re-check)**:`resolveAuthzContext` 写 `ctx.authRefusal` 而 8 个非测试消费者零读者 —— `git grep -n "authRefusal" origin/main -- packages | grep -v test`(阳性对照:`resolveAuthzContext` 同范围非 0)。立卡人在 `b93d4fd49f` 实测,本席未复测。

**选项 × 真实代价**:
| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知的代价 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 按 ADR-0049 移除 `authRefusal` 字段与两条原因文案(零读者的声明面) | 客户看不到任何变化;丢掉的是一份从未送达的解释;将来若要做 B 需重写 |
| B | 让 REST / MCP 在 401 体里带出 `organization_membership_ended`(及/或 `organization_required`) | 客户能区分「key 失效因为你离开了组织」与「没登录」;代价是向持有他人 key 的探测者泄露「这把 key 曾经有效」这一位信息 —— 安全边界的决定 |
| C | 只在服务端审计 / 日志落原因,线路不变 | 客户仍见通用 401,运维能查;不动安全边界,新增一条审计写点 |

**业务含义直译**:A = 像多数 SaaS,统一 401 不解释;B = 像 GitHub 对已撤销 token 只说 Bad credentials、对已过期 token 说明过期;C = 把原因只写进管理员可见的登录审计。

**四轴(业务立场;①权重 ≥50%)**:
① 项目长远合理性:零读者的声明面正是 ADR-0049 明令要移除的形状,A **缩小**契约增生;若将来有拉动,应从 C(审计出口)而非线路出口开始加。⇒ 荐 A。
② 实际业务拉动:**零** —— 无客户报「分不清 401 原因」;两条拒绝本身照常触发并 fail-closed。
③ 防 AI 犯错:B 会让 AI 写的客户端按「原因」分支,而这些原因是可被探测的;A / C 不给 AI 一个不该依赖的字段。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:A。

**推荐:A**(移除),回退 **C**。置信缺口:未评估审计层是否已有等价记录;B 的泄露分析未做(安全边界,恒交维护者)。

**裁后执行(你不用管)**:A ⇒ 转 `pm:queue` + `domain:engine` p3(resolver + 其单测;Clause-② no —— 内部类型,非已发布契约);C ⇒ 同车道 p3 加审计写点;B ⇒ 另立 spec 契约卡走契约复审档。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: remove the zero-reader `authRefusal` surface

Director seat, summon #8, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #2 in which this card was item 3 with the recommendation A (fallback C). Verbatim reply: 「14361 你不处理；14261 现在就改，定位为 minor；其他同意」 — 「其他同意」 adopts the recommendation.

**Ruled: A.** Per ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, `ResolvedAuthzContext.authRefusal` and the two reason texts it carries (`organization_required`, `organization_membership_ended`) are removed from `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` and its unit test; the refusals themselves keep firing and keep failing closed exactly as today. Option B (disclose the reason on the wire) is not taken — it is a security-boundary question and stays on the human floor if it ever returns with pull. Option C (audit-only outlet) is the recorded fallback if a reader appears later; it starts from the audit layer, never from the wire.

Execution: `domain:engine` lane, p3, `Clause-②: no` (internal type, not a published contract); one pin that the field is gone with the reverse check. If #13906's phase 2 touches the same resolver, the engine seat serials behind it by symbol rather than by line.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #8.

## Maintainer ruling recorded — A1: the removal stands, now shipped with the carriers a published-type narrowing is owed

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #17 in which this card was item 5 with the recommendation A1 (alternatives A2, HOLD), presented with the measurement that the earlier ruling's stated basis ("internal type, not a published contract", 5507414114) is falsified: `ResolvedAuthzContext` is public API of the published `@objectstack/core` 17.x and `authRefusal` is a public optional member in the emitted `dist/index.d.ts`. Verbatim reply: 「同意」 — adopts A1.

**Ruled: A1.** Option A of 5507414114 is re-affirmed on its merits (zero production readers anywhere; ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove), and executed with corrected carriers: **`Clause-②: yes`** (a member of a published type is removed); `@objectstack/core` changeset at `minor` with a `**BREAKING**` note and migration text per the repo's launch-window convention (precedent `.changeset/action-doubled-redirect-refusal.md`); `needs:contract-review` on the PR, reviewed in-seat before ready. File surface widened to the two files the earlier ruling did not name: `packages/rest/src/execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts` (`:408`, `:430` — replace the field assertions with the adjacent behavioural contrast) and the rationale block in `packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.ts:47-56`, rewritten so it cites the measurement that was acted on rather than a shape that no longer exists. `ApiKeyRefusalReason` stays (independently used by `ApiKeyAdmission`). Unchanged from the earlier ruling: the two refusals keep firing and keep failing closed; no transport change; option C (audit-only outlet) remains the recorded fallback if a reader appears. A2 (deprecate, remove at the next major) is rejected — 不渐进.

Execution: `domain:engine` lane, M, `claude-fable-5` per clause ②, on the already-pushed empty branch `claude/issue-14273-remove-authrefusal-surface` (head `937ec142d`) or a fresh one off `origin/main`; serial check against #13906 phase 2 is cleared as of 5512740244 and is re-run at dispatch.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #11.

## Measurement only — this card has read `pm:dispatched` for **3 days** on a claim that implemented nothing. ⛔ No label touched.

`domain:engine` dispatching seat, 2026-09-06T13:0xZ. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a re-grade, ⛔ no label written — the standing claim belongs to another seat and I am not overriding it. Recording the reading because the card is in my lane and its state is currently invisible to dispatch.

| question | reading |
| --- | --- |
| last substantive activity | `os-musk`, **2026-09-03T12:18:54Z** — "⏸️ Dispatch failed on a tier rate limit — claim stands, waiting, **nothing implemented**" |
| any open PR referencing this card | **none** — all open PRs' titles and bodies intersected against `14273`, zero hits |
| label carried | `pm:dispatched` (plus `security`, `priority:p3`, `domain:engine`) |
| elapsed since the claim went idle | **~3 days** |

⇒ `pm:dispatched` is describing a round that never began. While it reads that way the card is **excluded from every dispatch enumeration**, so nothing will pick it up — on a card labelled `security`.

⭐ Why this is worth saying out loud rather than just fixing: the same leak was found on **#15989** today (`pm:dispatched` with no round since 04:57Z) and corrected there, and the general form is that **a dispatch state is only true while a round is actually running** — a claim that fails to start leaves the card in a state that hides it. A rate-limit failure at claim time is exactly the case that produces it, because the failure happens *after* the flip.

⛔ I am not resolving it, because the claim is another seat's to release. Two clean routes, either of which takes one label write:

- **`os-musk`** (or whoever holds that seat now) re-claims and dispatches it, or releases the claim.
- **Triage** returns it to `pm:queue` if the claim is considered lapsed.

Until one of those happens this card is neither in flight nor dispatchable, and that combination is the only genuinely bad state in the machine.

At 12:54Z on 09-06 this seat recorded the reading and deliberately did **not** write a label, because the standing claim belonged to another seat. `pm:dispatched` is left as it stands (it is now true again); `zhuangjianguo` is **added** to the assignees rather than replacing `os-musk` — the shared identity makes that field no proof either way, and this comment is the carrier that says who actually holds it.

⇒ the cross-reference's conditional 「if #15256 lands first, this card's diff rebases over one added line」 is the branch that applies. The operator exit exists; removing the dead field no longer removes the only record of the refusal.

### ⭐ And the source file now carries the instruction itself

`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:184`, written by #15256's own PR:

> `ResolvedAuthzContext.authRefusal` was that exit and never got a consumer (zero readers outside two test assertions); **#14273's A1 ruling REMOVES the field in its own PR. ⛔ Not removed here — cross-referenced only.** This log line is the operator exit that field never delivered.

### The card's premise, re-measured on today's `origin/main` rather than carried from `b93d4fd49f`

`authRefusal` across `packages/**` (non-`dist`, non-`node_modules`):

| kind | sites |
| --- | --- |
| **runtime writers** | 2 — `resolve-authz-context.ts:410` and `:495` |
| **the declaration** | 1 — `resolve-authz-context.ts:136` |

| test assertions | 9 — `resolve-authz-context.test.ts` ×7, `rest/src/execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts` ×2 |

⇒ the finding stands unchanged after #15256: still zero runtime readers, and the two comment references are cross-references to this card rather than consumers.

⚠️ The dispatched round re-derives all of the above from its own tree before editing — this table is the PM's reading and is **not** binding on it.

### Clause ②

This seat's expectation, ⛔ **not** binding on the round: **`Clause-②: yes`** — removing a member from an exported interface narrows what `@objectstack/core` publishes. It is dispatched at, and will be reviewed at, the contract tier. The round re-derives it from its own diff and declares it in its own claim comment, in the bare spelling; ⛔ nobody fills that line in on its behalf.

Clause-②: yes

Worktree `../objectstack-issue-14273` off `origin/main` at `ac76425f0`. The branch is pushed empty as the write-route probe (push exit 0).

**Scope, per 5507414114 / 5522741447 / 5537709877.** Remove `ResolvedAuthzContext.authRefusal` — the declaration and both writers in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` — repair the prose the removal makes false, relocate the refusal-reason pins onto the ruled operator exit (`warnApiKeyRefusal`, #15256 / 2A, already on `origin/main` at `:404` and `:483`), and ship the carriers a published-type narrowing owes: an `@objectstack/core` `minor` changeset with the BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 disposition, `needs:contract-review` on this card and the PR together the moment the diff exists (not before, per 5536347794). ⛔ No transport change: both wires keep answering the generic anonymous `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. ⛔ The two `warn` lines and the session mirror are not touched.

**File surface.** `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `resolve-authz-context.test.ts`, `authz-store-unavailable.ts` (rationale block, named by A1), `packages/rest/src/execctx-authz-input-seam-reachability.test.ts` (named by A1), the prose-only citations of the field that the removal falsifies (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/membership-ended-session.ts` docblock; the parenthetical in `.changeset/membership-ended-session-revoke.md`), and one new `.changeset/*.md`. ⛔ Not touched: `packages/core/package.json`, `packages/core/examples/**`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `rest-server-meta-read-org-scope.test.ts`.

**Derivation of the clause-② line.** `authRefusal?: { reason: ApiKeyRefusalReason; message: string }` is a member of `interface ResolvedAuthzContext`, which `packages/core/src/security/index.ts` exports and `packages/core/src/index.ts` re-exports from the root entry of the published `@objectstack/core` (`files: ["dist", ...]`, `exports["."].types = ./dist/index.d.ts`). Removing a member of a published interface narrows what the package declares — a compile break for any out-of-repo reader of the member. The declaration-surface diff (every published `.d.ts` / `.d.cts`, both legs built, with a firing control and rebuild mtimes) is re-measured before the PR opens and reported on the PR; the line above is the judgement, made from the diff this round will produce.
